description:
Activate Xander's Lounge's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
Bone Miser and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Golgari Findbroker.
Golgari Findbroker enters the battlefield, returning Xander's Lounge from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Xander's Lounge ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
